description.zh:
Agent提供商。

- JVS Computer：填入OpenClaw。
- OpenClaw：填入OpenClaw。
- Hermes Agent：填入HermesAgent。
description.en:
The Agent provider.

- JVS Computer: set to OpenClaw.
- OpenClaw: set to OpenClaw.
- Hermes Agent: set to HermesAgent.

description.zh:
通道配置JSON字符串。

- 简单配置模式示例：
```json
{
    "appKey": "abc",
    "appSecret": "efg"
}
```

- 自定义配置模式示例
```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "clientId": "xxx",
  "clientSecret": "xxx"
}
```
description.en:
The channel configuration JSON string.

- Simple configuration mode example:
```json
{
    "appKey": "abc",
    "appSecret": "efg"
}
```

- Custom configuration mode example:
```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "clientId": "xxx",
  "clientSecret": "xxx"
}
```

description.zh:
通道名称。

如果不填写，系统会自动使用Code作为名称。
description.en:
The channel name.

If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically uses the value of Code as the name.

title.zh: 配置Agent运行时的三方通道
title.en: Configure a third-party channel for agent runtime

descriptions.zh:
您可以为无影 Agent 管理中心内的 JVS Computer、OpenClaw、Hermes Agent等 Agent 运行时资源配置三方通道，作为AgentIM通道之外扩展的Agent通信方式。

请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解无影 Agent 管理中心的操作与使用。
descriptions.en:
You can configure third-party channels for Agent runtime resources such as JVS Computer, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent in the Wuying Agent Management Center. These channels serve as extended Agent communication methods beyond the AgentIM channel.

Before you call this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the operations and usage of the Wuying Agent Management Center.
